history.emptyHint: Songs you have listened to show up here by date
history.subtitle: {artist} · {time}
history.clearBody: Every play record is deleted and cannot be restored. The queue and settings are not affected.

offline.noInterfaceHint: Connect to a network and try again.
offline.unreachableHint: Check your connection and try again.

player.queueFull: The queue is full ({count} songs at most); nothing was added
player.stoppedAfterFailures: {count} songs in a row could not be played; playback stopped
player.previewPlaying: Only a preview of "{title}" is available
player.outputDeviceFailed: The audio output device is unavailable; playback paused
player.outputDeviceFellBack: The audio output device is unavailable; switched to the system default

playerPage.queueShuffleNote: The shuffle order follows positions; dragging only swaps songs, not the order
playerPage.queueClearBody: Every song in the queue is removed and playback stops. Play history and settings are not affected.

playback.formatPriorityHint: Which format to pick when a source offers both
playback.rememberPositionHint: After a temporary play or reopening the app, the queue goes on from where it was
playback.tempPlayRewind: Rewind when returning to the queue
playback.tempPlayRewindHint: Go back a little from where the queue was, so it is easier to pick up
playback.skipPreviewClipsHint: Skip songs that only have a preview clip; when off, play the preview and mark it
playback.restartRewindHint: After reopening the app, resume a little before where you left off
playback.playHistoryLimitHint: Older records are deleted automatically; lowering the number deletes them right away
playback.autoScrollToCurrent: Scroll to the current song when it changes
playback.autoScrollToCurrentHint: While the queue list is open, it scrolls to the song that starts playing

network.clearBody: Cached artwork is deleted and downloaded again when needed. Your settings and data aren't affected.

plugins.noneInstalledHint: Pick plugins to install in the Available tab.
plugins.sourceLocal: Installed from a file or URL
plugins.addedAccess: The new version asks for more than the installed one. It is only updated after you confirm.
plugins.loginWarning: This script will access these sites as you, with your sign-in.
plugins.unofficial: Unofficial source: FMP hasn't reviewed this plugin.
plugins.removeBody: The plugin, its data, its sign-in and its cache are deleted. Songs stay and show "Source not installed".
plugins.upToDate: All plugins are up to date
plugins.checkFailed: Some repositories couldn't be read; there may be more updates
plugins.hashMismatch: The repository was just updated. Try again later.
plugins.manifestMismatch: The plugin file doesn't match the repository; nothing was installed
plugins.appUpdateRequired: This plugin requires a newer FMP
plugins.indexNeedsAppUpdate: This repository requires a newer FMP
plugins.urlInvalid: Enter a URL that starts with https
plugins.indexWarning: Unofficial source: FMP hasn't reviewed the plugins in this list.

onboarding.title: Install plugins to start searching
onboarding.body: Plugins connect FMP to music sources. Pick the ones you want; you can change this any time in Settings > Plugins.

accounts.none: No sources to sign in to
accounts.noneHint: Install a plugin that supports sign-in, then sign in here.
accounts.browseAsLoggedIn: Browse and play while signed in
accounts.automationRisk: Many requests while signed in may be treated as automated (unconfirmed)
accounts.invalidatedPrompt: The sign-in to {name} is no longer valid
accounts.noMethod: Signing in to {name} isn't available on this platform yet
accounts.logoutBody: FMP deletes its sign-in data for this source. The "Browse and play while signed in" setting stays.
accounts.qrTitle: Sign in to {name} with a QR code
accounts.qrWaiting: Scan the QR code with the app on your phone
accounts.webStuckBody: The page stopped while redirecting. Retry opens the sign-in page again; you usually won't need to enter your password again.
accounts.webStuckRestart: It still didn't finish. Close FMP, open it again and choose "Sign in on the web" once more; the sign-in on the web is kept.
accounts.cookieStep1: Sign in to the website in a browser on your computer.
accounts.cookieStep2: Press F12 to open the developer tools, reload the page in the Network tab and pick a request to that website.
accounts.cookieStep3: Find "Cookie" in the request headers, copy the whole value and paste it above.
accounts.cookieFile: You can also paste a cookies.txt file (Netscape format) exported by a browser extension.
accounts.cookieWarning: Cookies are your sign-in. Don't share them. FMP keeps them only on this device.
accounts.cookieEmpty: No cookies found. Paste name=value pairs or the contents of a cookies.txt file.
accounts.cookieRejected: {name} didn't accept these cookies. Copy them again from a page where you're signed in.
accounts.loginRejected: {name} didn't accept the sign-in. Try again.

errors.network: Network connection failed. Check your connection and try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests to {source}. Try again later.
errors.credentialInvalid: Your sign-in to {source} has expired. Sign in again.
errors.verificationRequired: Verification required by {source}. Sign in, paste a cookie, or try again later.
errors.notFound: Not found. It may have been removed.
errors.parseError: The response format of {source} changed. An update may be needed.
